# Neon Transit

An original 80-second instrumental electronic score for Bittrees World: 96 BPM, minor/add-nine synth pads, pulsing bass, delayed arpeggios and restrained percussion. No movie recording, sampled audio or existing melody is used.

The MP3 is served by each world node at `/music/neon-transit-v1.mp3`. The existing Radio play/pause and volume controls manage playback; parcel audio continues to duck the score. The station repeats the score on its shared UTC timeline without generated announcements or a remote music service.

Composition source: `scripts/compose-world-score.py`. Recreate with Python, NumPy and ffmpeg from the repository root. The composition and recording are provided under the repository's MIT license.
